## PR description
### [Recipe] Document MiniMax H3 ROCm (gfx950) BF16 serving  [labels: documentation, ready, ROCm]
Documents validated AMD ROCm (gfx942 / gfx950) serving for MiniMax H3, which the existing recipe only covered on CUDA/NVIDIA.

Changes (2 files):
    - recipes/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3.md — new AMD ROCm section:
    - Single-GPU (CPU offload) and four-GPU (Ulysses SP + text-encoder TP + tiled VAE PP) serve commands
    - --diffusion-attention-backend FLASH_ATTN (AITER packed varlen attention) on both gfx942 and gfx950; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES, no [fa4]/FlashInfer
    - Prebuilt image vllm/vllm-omni-rocm:minimax-h3 bundles TorchCodec + ffmpeg → all tasks work
    - Validated evidence: gfx942 (external #732) + gfx950 (this work)
    - docs/models/supported_models.md — mark MiniMax H3 AMD GPU supported, with an H3 footnote scoping validation to gfx942/gfx950.

Validation: MiniMax H3 T2VA generates valid H.264 + 32 kHz audio on gfx950 (single + 4-GPU; FLASH_ATTN ~2× faster than SDPA), and end-to-end in the prebuilt ROCm image. gfx942 figures from vllm-project/recipes#732.
